audit: Adversarial UI and UX acceptance checks for A1 academy
method: Isolated Chromium/Playwright contexts through browser-view; synthetic learner state only. Views inspected at 1440, 390 and 320 CSS pixels, English and Italian. Screenshots manually inspected and live controls exercised.

scoring.rubric: Ten areas with two equally weighted observable acceptance checks each. A pass needs at least 19 of 20 and no unresolved critical/high findings.
scoring.meaning: This is a measured acceptance-check score, not a human learner usability-study score or a claim that every page and answer has been tested.

checks.observed: All eight new route states render an h1 and stay within a 1440px viewport in EN and IT.
The same route states pass at 390px and 320px; all three programme lengths also pass at both widths.
EN/IT route headings, programme choices, page browser, filters and main interface strings observed in the 48-case route matrix. Italian learning targets remain in Italian.
An actual wrong grammar answer, correction message, hint, source picker and page search operate in Italian; html lang is it.
Radio answers can be selected with Space; ordering tokens can be activated with Enter and the sentence can also be typed and submitted with Enter.
Answer control has a visible 3px solid focus outline; next-day button and day selector focus the exact day heading.
Grammar answer and production fields resolve by explicit accessible labels; HTML limits are 500 and 2000 characters.
Grammar answer, hint use, personal writing, unit completion, companion answer and reference note survive reload.
Wrong first answer remains false after a correct repair; repair is explicitly marked supported. All questions remain revisitable.

checks.check: Assistance cannot be hidden by reload
checks.observed: A due-mode correction after same-day feedback remains supported; a hint revealed before reload remains supported after reload.
Due mode starts with a blank answer and covered feedback. A later-day unaided recall records an independent attempt without rewriting the first attempt.
Unit completion is disabled until all exercises have been solved, at least three production words exist, and every writing self-check is ticked; completion persists.
Practice page saves an original response, offers a model, requires explicit self-check, then saves completion. Source picker, search and page route are operable.
Reference pages accept optional saved notes and explanatory models but have no exercise-completion control or completion award.
Programme selection survives reload; switching preserves completed grammar. Interface states that a different programme starts its day checklist again.
First day stays disabled until required units and mission are complete; later days cannot skip earlier days; stored day progress resumes; grammar/application buttons open exact routes.
A grammar word can be starred, opened in the personal word bank, revealed and self-rated; next review date is stored.
Source selection, empty search state, restored full page list and selection of an exact source page all work in Italian.
5/10/15/20/30/45/60-minute choices persist through reload at 1440/390/320: 21 successful budget-width combinations without document overflow.
No browser pageerror events during the 48 route checks, 18 programme layout checks and functional journeys; current TypeScript and academy ESLint checks pass.

findingsAndFixes.finding: A generic full-sentence answer label conflicted with verb-only and phrase-only exercises.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Use a neutral Italian-answer label; the exercise prompt defines answer scope.

findingsAndFixes.finding: UI completion gates initially differed from engine minimum-word and sequential-day requirements.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Match three-word production threshold, all rubric checks and current-day programme gate; expose reason when disabled.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Reference pages had no task rubric but could previously enter the exercise completion flow.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Render reference guidance and optional saved notes with no exercise completion credit.

findingsAndFixes.finding: A later independent recall could accidentally reuse visible previous answers or disappear before its feedback was read.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Blank the local recall response, hide prior feedback and preserve the selected review queue until mode is refreshed.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Same-day feedback and hint-before-reload could make a supported correction appear independent.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Root engine constrains independent recall by date and records hintDates; UI persists every hint reveal and tests both adversarial flows.

findingsAndFixes.finding: The mobile step label Understand wrapped to a dangling final letter.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Use the concise step label Learn; retain the Italian label Capisci.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Long programme pages required excessive scrolling to reach the next study day.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Add a next-day button and native day jump selector that move focus to the exact heading.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Programme-switch copy did not explain that only the active programme day checklist is retained.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: State that selecting a different programme starts a new day checklist while learned unit and lesson evidence is kept.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Seven time choices could overflow narrow plan layouts.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Root updated time-choice layout; all seven options verified at three widths.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Muted text on tinted assistance panels had less contrast than the main paper surface.
findingsAndFixes.resolution: Darken assistance-panel copy to #455849 and make word-save targets 44px.

limitations: No real learner study, lecturer observation session or timing study was conducted; estimated study minutes are not measured learning durations.
No screen reader, mobile operating-system browser, high-zoom browser or colour-vision simulation was exercised. Keyboard and accessible control names were checked in Chromium.

Functional grammar journey covered the noun-gender unit and an Italian essere error/help path; UI did not exhaustively answer every one of the 224 exercises. Separate engine/content audits cover answer structure and curriculum.

Source companion UI was exercised on representative practice and reference pages, not every page. The final source data had no needs-review entry during the supplemental run, so that branch was not independently browser-exercised.
Private real learner state and local databases were not used by the audit. Synthetic completed units and missions were used only inside an isolated test context to exercise programme gating.
Screenshot and raw browser outputs remain ignored under work/academy-ui; this document records the durable observations without learner state or source extracts.
